content.full_text: HTW Berlin - University of Applied Sciences - studies, research, further education International Pathways Abroad Studying abroad Application Application Application deadlines Please register by January 15th for the following winter semester & complete your application by February 25th at the latest July 15th for the following summer semester & complete your application by August 25th at the latest Requirements Proof of completing at least 60 Bachelor-credits (ECTS) before starting the exchange semester is required (does not apply to students attending a double degree programme) Language qualification (grades from high schools or equal cannot be recognized as proof of language proficiency) for English-taught programs: at least GER B2.2 (A-levels certificate is not sufficient) English-taught programs in Australia, Canada, New Zealand and the USA: at least GER C1 French- taught programs: at least GER B2 Italian-taught programs: at least GER B1 Spanish- taught programs: at least GER B1 Accepted proof of language proficiency can for example be obtained through Successfully completing a HTW language course of the required language level (Unicert certificate) Recognized external language tests like TOEFL, IELTS, TOEIC , Cambridge Assessment or similar Successfully completing a language courses of the required level from other universities or the VHS (Volkshochschule) Important: The proof of language proficiency has to be not older than 2 years. Grades from high schools or equal cannot be recognized as the proof of language proficiency Even if you fulfil all of the requirements, HTW Berlin cannot guarantee an exchange place at a specific partner university. Online Application Find your partner universities and the first step to registration & application here . After you have registered on our Mobility Online platform you can log in at any time using the following link to access your application and complete all the necessary steps: Mobility Online Login
